{{Quote|Very well, we will use your ship to lead a squadron of the Empire's fighters. Your knowledge of the weapon placements will help us destroy their defenses before they can fire on us. There will be no tricks, Captain Luca. I will be aboard your ship to see to it ''personally''.|Darth Vader, to Luca|<ref name="SWA" />}}
The '''Battle of Annamar''' was a battle between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] to stop the Rebellion's guerrilla tactics on Imperial cargo ships near the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Annamar]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|One of the Empire's transgalatic supply lines is no longer secure. Imperial convoys along the Corellian Trade Spine are suffering attacks at the hands of a Rebel force. At first they were merely an annoyance. But they have grown ''bolder''. Their attacks, more successful.|Emperor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to Darth Vader|<ref name="SWA" />}}
With their [[Abandoned droid factory|base]] hidden within an [[Annamar asteroid field|asteroid field]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] made continuous attacks on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. [[Wolf Squadron]]'s successful attacks took ships and weapons from the Empire which were later used directly against the Empire.<ref name="SWA" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] was able to steal an [[Imperial convoy ship]] carrying a vital piece of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] weapons system. After Wolf Squadron stole the piece of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], the Empire sent multiple ships into the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] to recapture the ship and the stolen unit, but no Imperial ships ever returned from the mission.<ref name="SWA" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|You don't have to do this, you know? If you take on an entire Rebel force&hellip; you ''will'' most probably be ''destroyed''. You can ''choose'' simply to walk away.''"<br />"''No. I can't.|Luca and Darth Vader|<ref name="SWA" />}}
Realizing that only the best [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the Empire could successfully retake the stolen part, the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] commanded [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to lead the mission to retrieve the unit. Upon reaching the asteroid field, Vader noticed a ship entering the field. Aboard was [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Luca/Legends|Luca]] on whom Vader used [[Mind trick/Legends|Force persuasion]] to retrieve information about his missions and the Rebel base.<ref name="SWA" />

After receiving the details about the Rebel base from Luca, Vader used Luca's ship, the ''[[Faithless/Legends|Faithless]]'', to lead a squadron of Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] to destroy the Rebel base. Luca provided the necessary codes to avoid and destroy the Rebels' [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] in the asteroid field. As the squadron came upon [[Annamar]], however, Luca lied to Vader about the base's outer defenses surrounding the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]]. The Empire's starfighters were destroyed in the ambush and the ''Faithless'' was forced to crash land on Annamar.<ref name="SWA" />

Vader forced Luca to take him to the Rebel base and later threw him aside once he had reached the base. Single-handedly, Vader destroyed the preliminary defenses of the Rebel base and, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitate]] and drop a fully armed [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing bomber]], managed to annihilate the entirety of the Rebel base and Wolf Squadron.<ref name="SWA" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|All that power and you just do as you're told. You're called "Lord," but you don't ''rule'' a thing. Not even ''yourself''.''"<br />"''A man in ''your position'' would be wise to watch his words.''"<br />"''Or what? You'll kill me? Your Emperor wouldn't want any survivors. There's no way you'll let me live. Even if you ''wanted'' to spare me, you ''couldn't''&mdash;because you have ''no will of your own'', Vader. You're just a ''toy soldier!''<nowiki></nowiki>|Luca and Darth Vader|<ref name="SWA" />}}
The only survivor of the destruction was Luca, whom Vader spared as a method of proving that he still maintained a will of his own. With his mission accomplished, Vader left Luca alone on the planetoid and then returned to his ship the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] to await new orders from the Emperor.<ref name="SWA" />
